THESIS_STRICT stage-02 _write_crs_comparability fails closed unless a manual reference XODR is present -- couples Phase-1 auto-map GENERATION to the Phase-2 manual map. Resolved by feeding installed Grid0828 (UTM32N) read-only; full THESIS_STRICT preserved (incl. stage-05 real-DEM enforcement).

stage-02 SUMO netconvert normalized node positions to a local origin (offset ~832671.6, ~5458670.9), moving geometry off the F1-verified global tmerc(0,0) frame WITHOUT recording the offset. stage-05 DEM sampler F1 contract then failed closed (no_frame_matches_osm_source). Fixed via TDD: --offset.disable-normalization keeps the global frame -> DEM elevation imports (32297 real records, 361.85-408.67m). This is why only a RETROFIT candidate ever had valid elevation: the clean end-to-end path was broken here.

stage-08 CARLA lane-successor invariant found 10565 driving lanes missing successors; the pipeline's autofix (UP_AUTOFIX_LANE_SUCCESSORS) is OFF by default so the pipeline crashed. Enabled it -> 10565/10565 lanes REPAIRED by inferring successors from road links; ZERO downgraded to type=none, so the drivable network is fully preserved (no artificial connectivity loss vs the manual map).
